title: Gaia NSS vetting, TOI-6666.01
summary: Gaia DR3 cone, SIMBAD cone and Gaia DR3 NSS two-body cross-match of the TOI-6666.01 host, as a discriminating test for the TOI-6666.01 repeat-event lead (one ~5.3 h feature at the start of sector 18, ΔT 171.5 d from the catalogued transit). An earlier ad-hoc SB2 attribution (P 4.8124683 d, e 0.053, K1 85.77 km/s, f(M) 0.31 Msun) was traced to Gaia source 4513527912472807936, 57.276 deg away, and is withdrawn; this campaign depends on it in no way. Runner: No light-curve product was retrieved; only image/table/text products are available to screen.

targets.name: TOI-6666.01
targets.position_source: NASA Exoplanet Archive TOI table (via campaigns/toi-6666-01.yaml; Gaia DR2 epoch J2015.5, verified reports/position-epoch-audit-01)

checks.name: Product integrity (SHA-256)
checks.note: 2 product(s) from gaia, simbad checksummed at first retrieval

checks.name: Gaia NSS astrometric vetting
checks.note: TOI-6666.01: no Gaia DR3 NSS two-body solution for source 2223770483452673408 (0.02" away); Gaia sensitivity is incomplete, so this is not proof of a single star

checks.name: Proper-motion propagation to the Gaia epoch
checks.note: the runner matches positions as given; reports/position-epoch-audit-01 (Gaia DR3 TAP, 2026-09-25) shows the TOI-table position is at epoch J2015.5, not J2000.0: TOI minus Gaia DR3 = (+0.8, -19.1) mas, equal to -0.5 yr x PM (+0.8, -18.5) mas; residual after propagation 0.6 mas. The 0.5-yr offset (0.019 arcsec) is far below the 5 arcsec match radius, so identification is unaffected

checks.note: cited source 4513527912472807936 (ICRS 287.16737, +16.85086) is 57.276 deg from the target; attribution withdrawn
